Title: Juste Shani + Jade & Naïa
Description:
JADE & NAÏA Jade and Naïa Franche are Franco-Congolese sisters raised in the Canary Islands, blending their multicultural roots into a unique sound. Since forming their duo in Brussels in 2018, they have evolved into a bold musical identity combining Afrolatin, reggaeton, R&B, and trap, with Spanish as their artistic language. With their authentic style and international ambitions, they are ready to make their mark on the global Latin music scene.

JUSTE SHANI Independent artist Juste Shani is a rapper with the sensitivity of a dreamer and the mindset of a winner. Her tracks combine powerful messages with hard-hitting bangers, all underpinned by her sharp, incisive lyrics. On stage, her energy effortlessly draws the audience into her world. This has already taken her to major venues, such as L’Olympia as the support act for IAM, and to festivals including Solidays, Lollapalooza and Les Ardentes. She has also made a name for herself internationally with tours in Chile and Brazil. In her latest EP, Diamant Noir, Juste Shani encourages everyone to turn vulnerabilities into strength and to shine with their own identity – a committed message from an artist who is very much of her time.

Juste Shani, just buy the tickets!

Title: Kodaline + Bertie Newman
Description:
For one final time, Kodaline returns to the place where their emotions have always found a home. This summer, the Irish quartet kicks off their ‘Farewell Tour’, a final, emotional journey that marks the closing chapter of a remarkable musical story. During this farewell tour, the band will travel the world to visit their fans one last time, with stops in Singapore, Tokyo, Sydney, Berlin, Paris and, of course… Brussels! Kodaline looks forward to seeing their Belgian fans on Thursday 26 November 2026 at Ancienne Belgique in Brussels.

Kodaline was formed in Swords, Ireland, by Steve Garrigan, Mark Prendergast, Jason Boland and Vinny May. What began as a local band grew to become a fixture on the international pop-rock scene. With their distinctive, emotionally charged songs and captivating melodies, the quartet has touched the hearts of millions of listeners. Inspired by bands such as Coldplay and Mumford & Sons, Kodaline developed a distinctive sound in which intimate ballads and warm indie pop blend seamlessly. Their journey spans from their debut album ‘In a Perfect World’ (2013), which sold over a million copies, to ‘One Day at a Time’ (2020), with ‘Coming Up For Air’ (2015) and ‘Politics of Living’ (2018) in between. Their discography is packed with unforgettable tracks, such as “All I Want”, “High Hopes” and “Brother”. Kodaline are a welcome guest on stages worldwide and, concert after concert, have built a rare, strong bond with their audience.

Title: Gotu Jim + igor
Description:
This is a Liveurope concert, the first European initiative that supports concert venues in promoting emerging musical talent from Europe.

Dutch rapper Gotu Jim —loosely translated from Sranang as “Golden Jim”—broke through in 2018 with the short but powerful track “Tweede Klas Shit.” He was signed by Abel and Faberyayo to their record label Burning Fik, and ever since, everything Gotu Jim touches turns to gold. Tracks like “Misschien (Kwijt)” have become festival staples, and in the meantime, he’s been bringing the house down in venues across the Netherlands and Belgium. This summer, he performed in front of a packed tent at Lowlands, while his recent single “Afterparty” has already racked up over 1.5 million streams. Faberyayo also makes another appearance on his latest track, “Lichten Van De Stad.”

Title: Froukje - 'Kijk Je Naar Mij?' Albumtour 2026 + Jaïr Faria
Description:
This is a Liveurope concert, the first European initiative that supports concert venues in promoting emerging musical talent from Europe.

“Iedereen Gaat Vreemd” – and Dutch singer-songwriter Froukje is following suit, crossing the border once again to head to Belgium. Her new album “Kijk Je Naar Mij?” is due for release on 2 October, and she is looking forward to presenting it in concert.

Froukje is one of the most distinctive and influential voices of her generation. Since 2020, her music has been streamed over 240 million times. With sold-out venues, packed festivals and a solid reputation on stage, she has firmly established herself in Dutch and Belgian pop music. Whilst her debut album was introspective, its follow-up, ‘Kijk Je Naar Mij?’, looks outwards: towards the world, towards love in all its forms, and towards the wonderful relationship she has with her own life as an artist. She wrote the album entirely herself and also produced most of it on her own. Singles such as “Iedereen Gaat Vreemd” and “Jaar Na Jaar” already give a taste of this: fresh, confident and with the ease of someone who knows exactly what they’re doing.

Supporting act: Jaïr Faria, a 22-year-old singer-songwriter from Amsterdam who combines pop, neo-soul and rock influences to create a unique, contemporary sound. With over ten years’ experience on stage and a background in performing arts, he performs moving songs with a powerful voice, accompanied live on piano and guitar.

Title: Double bill: Stefan Maier & Yuki Nakagawa
Description:
Collab with Futura Resistenza

The Canadian composer and artist Stefan Maier is originally from Vancouver, a city situated on the traditional, unceded territory of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh First Nations.

In his multimedia installations, performances, texts and compositions, Stefan Maier uses sound as a medium for exploring possible worlds. His practice explores the instability and resilience of matter, tracing the movement of sound through buildings, acoustic devices, instruments, software and bodies. Guided by this fascination with the properties of sound, Stefan Maier brings to light buried stories, sonic fictions and new ways of listening, perceiving and creating. At the crossroads of composition, research and speculation, his practice invites the audience to perceive sound as a living material, in a state of perpetual transformation.

In recent years, Stefan Maier’s work has been presented by, amongst others, the INA-GRM and the Festival d’Automne in France, the Julia Stoschek Foundation, the Haus der Kulturen der Welt in Germany and the Norwegian Ultima festival. His recent albums have been released on renowned labels such as Portraits GRM, Dinzu Artefacts, ETAT and Superpang. New releases are planned on the Mappa and XKatedral labels. With his unique approach to sound and space, Stefan Maier is part of a generation of artists who are constantly pushing the boundaries of contemporary music and sound art.

Description: The quartet presents their majestic second album following a European tour

Title: Wild Classical Music Ensemble & Fournèz
Description:
The Wild Classical Music Ensemble brings together musicians with and without disabilities. Their unique sound is a blend of punk/rock riffs, fanatical rhythms and fiery flute and synth flights, over which gravitate multi-voiced, multi-lingual vocals that scratch harshly as much as they comfort. In 2024 they met musicians from the local music scene in Réunion Island , where music is deeply rooted in Maloya and Sega. The adventure continues with the newly formed group Fournèz , which brings together Gilles Lauret (Danyèl Waro), Baptiste Clément (Mouvman alé), and Benjamin Rebolle (Mouvman alé, Alsimi). This artistic and human journey will culminate in 2026 with an album that builds bridges between cultures and peoples, released via Born Bad and Bongo Joe. The project aims to blend the participants’ diverse relationships with music and language, while snippets of poetry are tenderly exchanged between French and Creole. Singer Françoiz Breut was brought on board to bridge these different linguistic worlds and features on two songs of the album. Vyin mon dalon features Marie Lanfroy from Saodaj and Carlo de Sacco from Grèn sémé.

This concert will take place at Beursschouwburg.

Title: Arkane
Description:
Get ready for an extraordinary musical experience! Arkane , the vocal group that fuses the power of collective singing with the raw energy of rock and hard rock, invites you to an unforgettable concert on 28.11.2026 at the Ancienne Belgique. More than just a concert, Arkane is a shockwave, a cry from the heart, a celebration of music in all its forms. Under the musical direction of Emeline Burnotte, this 150-voice choir reinvents rock and hard rock standards, shattering clichés and revealing all the emotional power of these too-often overlooked genres.

Accompanied by a live band made up of Mat Mirol (bass), Emeline Podgornik (drums), Adrien Larock (keyboards), Jean-Bertrand Sellom and Greg Hallet (guitars) and directed by Simon Paco, Arkane's backing singers revisit the great classics and forgotten nuggets of protest music. On the programme: Muse, Imagine Dragons, Nightwish, Shaka Ponk, Placebo, Evanescence, Iron Maiden, U2 and many other surprises... A vibrant, organic and electrifying show that transcends the boundaries of traditional choral singing and takes you on a real musical and human adventure.

Title: Nightlab session: About Soukous w/ Dare Balogun
Description: Dare Balogun is a British-Nigerian DJ, writer, broadcaster and archivist based in London. His practice is committed to traditional African music: vinyl only, research-led, built for the dancefloor, and held together by one connected idea, that the dance forms of West and Central Africa (Highlife, Juju, Soukous, Makossa and Palm wine) are the foundation of modern Black dance music. Most of the practice runs through Roots to Rhythm, the project and living archive he co-founded with Grace Shelley: a monthly residency on NTS Radio and a series of listening sessions and parties. The work has moved between cultural institutions, listening bars, club nights and museums, from the Barbican and Southbank Centre in London to Public Records in New York, PAMM in Miami, Radio Radio in Amsterdam and SAVVY Contemporary in Berlin. ﻿

Title: Axelle Red
Description:
Her most recent studio album of own work, Exil , was released eight years ago. Her last visit to AB dates from late 2025 and it surprised us too when she turned up on stage here as an unannounced special guest of Roméo Elvis & Oscar and the Wolf.

In the meantime, Axelle Red took the time to set the bar very high for new songs, often up-tempo, with lyrics that can be read at many levels. Her new, long-awaited album is to be released at the end of 2026. And we are more than happy to share our AB with her for that.

For more than three decades, the Belgian singer-songwriter, pop and soul diva has been responsible for a long list of iconic songs like Sensualité , Parce que c’est toi , Je t’attends , Elle danse seule , Le monde tourne mal , À tâtons , Ma prière , Rester femme and Rouge ardent . With thirteen albums, millions of copies sold and tens of millions of streams every year, she developed - as humanist and feminist – into a unique artist who effortlessly combines emotion and commitment.

Axelle’s debut album Sans plus attendre was released in 1993. The pop-soul album was an unprecedented success: with more than 500,000 copies sold, it became one of the best selling albums in Belgian music history. Thanks to the concerts that followed and her second album À tâtons – recorded with some of the best known American soul musicians – she made her definitive international breakthrough.

Title: VOILÀ + NOT A TOY, Austin Giorgio
Description:
Gus Ross (vocals) was a street musician in London. Luke Eisner (guitar) worked as a model in the United States. The two met in 2014 on their first day at the USC Thornton School of Music in California. It turned out they both looked up to Avicii as a hero, and just a few hours later they had written their first song. They’ve been inseparable ever since.

Based in Los Angeles, they create exotic pop music that they write, record and produce themselves. VOILÀ really took off when Eisner landed a leading role in the popular Netflix series Tall Girl and the duo were asked to contribute two tracks to the soundtrack. Their contribution to JoJo Siwa’s The J Team (2022) earned them an Emmy Award nomination. VOILÀ has now released four albums and can count on a loyal community that calls itself “the magicians”.
